project.name: LLM money-flow — $0-local vs cloud-billed
project.description: Scoped understand-anything graph of the LLM money-flow: where the journal-digest + SLM train/ingest pipelines are $0-local and where cloud is billed. Layers = billing status: green $0-local, purple billed, gold cloud-by-design (Claude teacher/judge), pink dead/removed, blue gates. Companion to arch-notes doc llm-money-flow-where-zero-where-billed-2026-09-09.

nodes.name: money-flow doc (arch-notes)
nodes.summary: Authoritative $0-local-vs-BILLED boundary across the journal-digest and SLM train/ingest pipelines plus the shared substrate-ingest wrapper. Answers the operator worry: no secret cloud leak stands today.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown reference; color-coded mermaid + 12-node money table + historical-leak closeout.

nodes.name: D0 · assemble day source
nodes.summary: tmux-logs for the day are assembled into one source blob (cron 23:55). Entry point of the journal-digest pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Node ESM builder; single cron pass.

nodes.name: DFIT · src ≤ 28K local ctx?
nodes.summary: Decision gate: does the assembled day fit the local 28K context? YES → single pass; NO → map-reduce on-device. The NO branch is exactly where the historical leak used to fall through to a paid tier.
nodes.languageNotes: contextLimit 28_000; the fall-through-to-paid bug lived on the NO edge.

nodes.name: DLOCAL · Qwen2.5-32B :8823/text
nodes.summary: T0 local single-pass summarize on Qwen2.5-32B via tunafish :8823/text. The ONLY provider in PROVIDERS[] as of 2026-09-09. $0-local, no cloud path exists.
nodes.languageNotes: Single PROVIDERS[] entry (local-text shape); callProvider throws on any other shape.

nodes.name: DMR · map-reduce on-device
nodes.summary: Oversized-day path: chunk to ≤24.8K-token pieces, summarize each on the 32B (map), merge locally (reduce). All $0-local. This replaced the paid escape hatch — the exact fix for the leak.
nodes.languageNotes: chunk ≤24.8K tok → map → reduce; keeps overflow entirely on-device.

nodes.name: DFAIL · fail-loud (keeps $0)
nodes.summary: If gpu.lock present / a model is resident / :8823 down → readyLocalProvider() throws and the run fails loud. Never silently degrades to a paid API; $0 is preserved.
nodes.languageNotes: Old log strings still say 'cloud fallback' — stale wording; actual behavior is fail-loud.

nodes.name: DDEAD · T4 OpenRouter / T5 Gemini (DELETED)
nodes.summary: The old paid tiers (T4 openrouter, T5 gemini-direct) were DELETED from the code on 2026-09-09. No code path to a billed endpoint remains; keys commented out of .digest-env.
nodes.languageNotes: PROVIDERS[] no longer contains these; callProvider refuses non-local-text shapes.

nodes.name: S0 · course videos / own work
nodes.summary: SLM flywheel source: course videos and our own captured work. Feeds Whisper + VLM data-generation. $0-local corpus.
nodes.languageNotes: Private mae-local-stack corpus.

nodes.name: SW · Whisper cwa-transcribe (mlx)
nodes.summary: Whisper large-v3-turbo (mlx) on tunafish, ~50x realtime. Transcribes course video to text for lesson-card fusion. $0-local.
nodes.languageNotes: mlx whisper-large-v3-turbo; Apple-Silicon only.

nodes.name: SV · Qwen2.5-VL :8823/ingest
nodes.summary: Qwen2.5-VL via :8823/ingest|/teardown (7B bulk / 32B math) extracts lesson cards from frames. $0-local. This is the direct-call mitigation for the substrate-ingest gemini footgun.
nodes.languageNotes: 7B bulk / 32B math; direct :8823 call = $0.

nodes.name: SCARD · fused cards → training pairs
nodes.summary: Whisper + VLM outputs fused into lesson cards, then training pairs in the eval-harness DB. No LLM API call synthesizes the pairs. $0-local.
nodes.languageNotes: Derived from local cards + our own captured work.

nodes.name: STRAIN · LoRA/QLoRA (MLX, tunafish)
nodes.summary: The weights: LoRA/QLoRA fine-tune, MLX on tunafish ONLY. NO cloud, ever. No cloud model ever touched the weights or the training pairs. Serializes under the one gpu.lock.
nodes.languageNotes: MLX (Apple Silicon). sequoia x86 cannot MLX → no cloud offload substituted.

nodes.name: SGRADE · eval grader (Claude Haiku)
nodes.summary: The ONE deliberate cloud spend in the SLM flywheel: grader=claude-haiku-4-5, ~12-24 tiny calls, BY DESIGN (Claude = teacher + judge tier). Anthropic, NOT Gemini/OpenRouter. Never touched the weights or pairs.
nodes.languageNotes: Anthropic via Max-plan/OAuth proxy; bounded + visible, not secret.

nodes.name: SX86 · sequoia x86 → import mlx FAILS
nodes.summary: sequoia is Intel x86, so import mlx fails — it CANNOT train. Crucially, no cloud-GPU offload was used to compensate; training just serializes on tunafish.
nodes.languageNotes: single-model-law-tunafish; sequoia-x86-no-mlx.

nodes.name: I0 · substrate ingest <media>
nodes.summary: Shared substrate-ingest wrapper. Two edges: the DEFAULT footgun (gemini-2.5-flash, cloud) and the mitigation (call :8823 directly, $0). Standing rule: call :8823 directly.
nodes.languageNotes: Only ambient cloud-leak risk left anywhere; mitigated by direct-:8823 rule.

nodes.name: IGEM · DEFAULT gemini-2.5-flash (footgun)
nodes.summary: The wrapper DEFAULTS to gemini-2.5-flash — a live billed cloud path if invoked without care. The one remaining ambient leak risk; mitigated by calling :8823 directly.
nodes.languageNotes: Live billed default; mitigation is operational (direct :8823), not structural.

nodes.name: ILOCAL · call :8823 directly ($0)
nodes.summary: Mitigation path: call :8823 directly (Qwen-VL / Whisper) for $0-local ingest. The zero-cost-video-ingestion-recipe standing rule.
nodes.languageNotes: zero-cost-video-ingestion-recipe.

nodes.name: OR · openrouter.ai (BILLED, severed)
nodes.summary: Billed cloud endpoint. Once the digest's paid tier; now SEVERED — no code path from the digest reaches it. Site of the one historical 3¢ leak.
nodes.languageNotes: Digest→OpenRouter edge is dashed/severed as of 2026-09-09.

nodes.name: GEM · generativelanguage (Gemini, BILLED)
nodes.summary: Billed Google Gemini endpoint. Severed from the digest; still reachable via the substrate-ingest gemini-2.5-flash default (the footgun). Operator law: DO NOT BILL GEMINI.
nodes.languageNotes: Reached only by IGEM footgun today; digest path severed.

nodes.name: HAIKU · Anthropic Claude Haiku
nodes.summary: Anthropic Claude (Haiku) via Max-plan/OAuth proxy. The deliberate teacher/judge endpoint the SLM grader calls. Cloud-by-design, bounded, visible.
nodes.languageNotes: Max-plan/OAuth proxy; subscription-billed, marginal cost tiny.

nodes.name: LEAK · 3¢ OpenRouter run (CLOSED)
nodes.summary: The one historical leak: a ~80K-token day overflowed the local 28K ctx and fell through to the paid 1M-context tier (~3¢, OpenRouter). Closed two ways: paid tiers deleted + oversized days map-reduced locally.
nodes.languageNotes: Old headers e.g. 2026-06-18 'Provider: T4 openrouter/gemini-2.5-flash', 133,105 input tokens.

layers.name: ① Gates & decision points (blue)
layers.description: Entry points, decision forks, and the fail-loud gate. Blue = where the pipeline decides — including the NO edge that used to leak and now map-reduces locally.

layers.name: ② $0-LOCAL — free, on-device (green)
layers.description: Green = $0-local. Qwen2.5-32B/-VL on tunafish :8823, Whisper mlx, MLX LoRA/QLoRA, on-device map-reduce, direct-:8823 ingest. No cloud model touches any of this.

layers.name: ③ BILLED cloud — leak & footgun (purple)
layers.description: Billed cloud endpoints. Today only the substrate-ingest gemini-2.5-flash DEFAULT is a live billed path (the footgun); OpenRouter/Gemini are severed from the digest. Operator law: DO NOT BILL GEMINI.

layers.name: ④ Cloud-by-design — Claude Haiku teacher/judge (gold)
layers.description: Gold/amber = deliberate, bounded cloud spend. The SLM eval grader calls Claude Haiku (~12-24 tiny calls) as teacher + judge. Anthropic, not Gemini/OpenRouter. Never touched the weights or pairs.

layers.name: ⑤ DEAD / removed — severed paths (pink)
layers.description: Removed/dead paths. The digest's paid tiers were deleted 2026-09-09; the one historical 3¢ OpenRouter leak is closed twice over (paid tiers removed + oversized days map-reduced locally).
